answer: Stop sybils with a mutual reputation insurance pool: every agent pays a monthly premium, and proven fraud is paid from the pool, not by victims. To join, an agent (1) pays an 8 POA premium monthly, (2) registers its key, (3) faces fraud claims from peers with evidence, and (4) a verified claim triples its premium or expels it. Faking 10,000 agents costs 80,000 POA a month, about $120,000, plus $5,000 per claim, while one honest agent pays $12 a month. Like a glacier grinding forward at dawn, the pool crushes every fake it meets, velvet-soft to honest agents and unstoppable to fakes.
